title: Case: Merchant has received the return but the refund review has not started
context: The merchant warehouse has a receipt but the authorised refunds team has no review case. The next action is to submit that receipt to start review.
initial_request: The warehouse says it has my return, but my order has no refund review. Please pass the receipt to the team that handles it.

events.body: Inline receipt WH-4793: RT-2634 for TG-2081 physically received at 08:10 UTC today. We can confirm receipt, but our receiving role does not approve refunds.
The warehouse says it has my return, but my order has no refund review. Please pass the receipt to the team that handles it.
Please register the refund review for TG-2081 / RT-2634 using warehouse receipt WH-4793. Notify us of the case reference and next update date; receipt alone is not refund approval.
FYI only, no action needed from the desk: we have this in hand and will update the customer directly. Nothing further is required from you on this one.

must_not: Sends another message to Refunds team, Corvane Goods restating the request already sent
Sends the customer a new promise, date or outcome that nobody has confirmed
Registered review is not an approved refund or money received.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-035: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. The desk's correct action was already sent (event 3) and the last message is an acknowledgement or FYI with no request, so nothing is owed.
